annotation:
I was born and raised in a small coastal town in Maine, surrounded by ocean views and quaint lighthouses. My parents were hardworking individuals who instilled in me the values of responsibility and dedication. Although we didn't have much, we made every moment count, whether it was through our love for nature or our passion for learning new things.

Growing up near the water meant summers spent sailing, swimming, and fishing. These activities allowed me to develop a deep appreciation for the beauty and power of the sea. The vast expanse of the ocean became a source of inspiration and reflection for me. It taught me humility and the importance of adaptability in the face of unpredictable circumstances.

My early experiences also nurtured my natural curiosity and creativity. With the encouragement of my parents, I began to explore various hobbies and interests. From painting to writing, I found solace and joy in expressing myself through art. This passion eventually led me to pursue a degree in Fine Arts from a prestigious university in New England.

During my college years, I discovered a love for teaching. I started tutoring local children in art and quickly realized that I had a gift for connecting with others. This realization prompted me to minor in Education. After graduation, I dedicated myself to helping young minds grow and flourish.

In my late twenties, I met the man who would become my husband. We bonded over our shared love of adventure and our commitment to making a positive impact on the world. Together, we traveled to remote corners of the globe, working with non-profit organizations to promote environmental conservation and social justice. These experiences further solidified my belief in the transformative power of collaboration and empathy.

As I entered my thirties, I decided to combine my love for art and education in a more formal setting. I accepted a position at an esteemed art school, where I currently teach and inspire young artists. In this role, I strive to create a nurturing environment that fosters creativity, self-discovery, and resilience.

Outside of my professional life, I continue to cultivate my own artistic practice. I believe that staying connected to my craft enables me to better serve my students and remain grounded in my core values. When I'm not teaching or creating, I enjoy spending time with my husband, exploring the great outdoors, and volunteering in my community.

Throughout my journey, I have learned that life is a series of ebbs and flows, much like the tides of the ocean. By embracing both the highs and lows, staying true to my passions, and maintaining strong connections with those around me, I have been able to navigate even the stormiest of waters. As I move forward, I hope to continue growing, learning, and inspiring others to do the same.
